notes.purpose: Synthetic benchmark for GRM-style latent-state modeling of integrative physiology.
notes.not_biology: This is not a biological simulator or proof of TCM. It is a controlled benchmark.
contrarian_examples: One syndrome-like label is split into hidden subtypes.
Some labels merge into a bridge state.
Treatment response depends partly on hidden subtype, not label.
recommended_tasks: Recover latent state from observations only.
Detect mismatch between latent clusters and semantic labels.
